why: issue 2018 / RFC-0108 As-built -- hand a level's sched-context budget to the kernel that enforces it on the level's thread (NuttX SCHED_SPORADIC, Linux SCHED_DEADLINE), so the executor does not throttle the level a second time: one enforcer per level. No rclcpp/rclrs counterpart (no executor-side budgets). See `rust:Executor::set_level_sched_context`.
